desc:
WHIPPED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored strawberry frosting with a light, airy texture; Great for icing baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: Makes a perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: Eight 12 oz tubs of Betty Crocker Whipped Artificially Flavored Strawberry Mist Frosting
features:
Key Features:

Whipped, Light & Fluffy Texture — Designed for easy spreading or piping with a soft, airy consistency. 

Strawberry Mist Flavor — Artificially flavored strawberry frosting offering a fruity, sweet taste. 

Gluten-Free — Formulated without gluten and suitable for those with dietary restrictions. 

Ready to Use — Just pop open the tub and frost—no mixing or preparation needed. 

Pantry-Stable — Shelf-stable until opened; refrigerate leftovers for up to two weeks. 

Benefits:

Speedy Decorating — Perfect for quick fixes, especially when you need easy dessert prep. 

Fun & Light — Whipped texture gives a homemade feel and is mild on sweetness. 

Kid-Friendly — Sweet strawberry flavor and fluffy texture are a hit with children.

Versatile for Baking — Great for cakes, cupcakes, sugar cookies, or whimsical dessert toppers.
ingredients: Sugar, Palm Oil, Water, Corn Syrup, Corn Starch. Contains 2% or less of: Monoglycerides, Salt, Cellulose Gel, Polysorbate 80, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Cellulose Gum, Citric Acid, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Red 40, Blue 2. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
